core_types.name: Repository
core_types.description: Pure Go Git repository handle coordinating worktree, storage, and remotes

core_types.name: Worktree
core_types.description: Filesystem working directory manager for checkout, status, and commit

core_types.name: ObjectStorage
core_types.description: Plumbing storage abstraction for blobs, trees, commits, and tags

call_paths.path: Worktree.Status() -> index.Read() -> file stat walk -> diff generation

concurrency_model.type: Thread-Safe Storage with Synchronized Worktree Mutexes
concurrency_model.synchronization: Internal storage mutexes; worktree operations require single-caller locking

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: context.Context passed to network operations (Fetch, Pull, Push) and packfile decoders
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: Socket and packfile stream closure on context abort

retry_model.strategy: No internal network retry; caller manages transport reconnections

boundaries.network: Git Smart HTTP/HTTPS, SSH, and Git daemon wire protocols
boundaries.os: Local filesystem (.git directory, working files) or pure in-memory storage (memory.Storage)
boundaries.serialization: Git packfile, index file (DIRC), commit/tree/blob objects
